meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂目标拆成可核验步骤并循环推进
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果面对多步任务且想留痕、按步骤推进
copy.tagline_en: Break complex goals into verifiable steps and iterate to completion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you face multi-step tasks and want to keep evidence-based progress

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把目标拆成一串细颗粒、必须凭真实证据验证的步骤:先登记目标和成功标准,再把每个动作同步进实时计划清单,并能在上下文丢失后从检查点接着跑。
howto.when: 当你要求 ulw-loop、ulw,或需要可检查点的长时任务交付时,它接管执行。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 帮我登记这次的目标和成功标准。
say.note: 会先按 define-goal 写入目标状态。

say.text: 跑一下 ulw-loop 状态,列出当前目标和进度。
say.note: 读取 .omo/ulw-loop 下的 CLI 状态。

say.text: 把这次改动拆成逐步任务,每步都要有可观察证据。
say.note: 每个成功判据都绑定真实证据。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude decomposes the objective into ultra-granular, evidence-bound steps: it registers the goal and success criteria first, mirrors each step into a live plan checklist, and can resume from checkpoints after context loss.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for ulw-loop or ulw, or want durable, checkpointed execution of long-running delivery work.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to register this goal and its success criteria.
say_en.note: Writes goal state via define-goal first.

say_en.text: Show ulw-loop status and list current goals and progress.
Break this change into steps, each with observable evidence.
